title: Vote on releasing Apache Iceberg Rust 0.10.0 RC3
summary: Danny Jones called a vote to release Apache Iceberg Rust 0.10.0 from tag v0.10.0-rc.3. Voters reported verifying checksums, signatures, license files and headers, the build and tests, and the pyiceberg-core build and tests; Matt Butrovich also ran DataFusion Comet CI against the candidate. Kevin Liu first voted +1 and noted that Python build directories trip the license header check. On July 14 he changed his vote to -1 because the iceberg-storage-opendal, iceberg-catalog-loader and iceberg-cache-moka crates lack LICENSE and NOTICE files, and said a new release candidate is needed. The thread ends with that message and no result is stated.

positions.stance: The candidate verifies on macOS and DataFusion Comet CI, which runs Iceberg Java 1.10 Spark tests against iceberg-rust, is green with it.
The candidate passes the checklist; bindings/python/.venv/ and .pytest_cache/ should be added to the ignore list in .licenserc.yaml.
Three crates are missing LICENSE and NOTICE files and should not be published that way, so the vote changes to -1 and a new RC is needed.

outcome.note: No result is stated in the thread. Before the -1 there were +1 votes marked binding from liurenjie1024, kevinjqliu and amogh-jahagirdar and seven marked non-binding; kevinjqliu then changed his vote to -1 and asked for a new RC.

why_it_matters: Each published crate needs its own LICENSE and NOTICE files; their absence in three crates drew a -1 on this candidate.
